scripts.translation:

弱小卑贱的家伙，就去地狱里烂着吧！
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:

Gleipnir is said to be so strong that not even the Fenrir Wolf could break it! I take great pride in being able to create this!
[Rebarev Doug]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We are Crusaders that have
been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我们是十字军，一直在为即将到来的圣战进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As our forefathers have
done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
正如我们的先辈在一千年前所做的那样，当那一天到来时，我们将歼灭恶魔大军。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you have any questions about Crusaders, feel free to ask me.
I may be too old and weak for fighting, but I will spread our message as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
对十字军有什么疑问，尽管问我。
我虽年老体弱，不能再上阵，也会尽力宣扬我们的信念。

scripts.text: What is Holy Cross?
scripts.translation: 什么是圣十字攻击？

scripts.text: What is Grand Cross?
scripts.translation: 什么是圣十字审判？

scripts.text: What is Sacrifice?
scripts.translation: 什么是牺牲？

scripts.text: What is Gleipnir?
scripts.translation: 什么是魔法铁链？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Holy Cross is the first manifestation of a Crusader's faith. By making the sign of the cross, Crusader's can inflict a holy attack on their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
圣十字攻击，是十字军信仰最初的体现。
画出十字圣印，就能向敌人施以圣属性攻击。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Monsters that are weak against holiness, particularly the Undead, will be blinded by the light of the Holy Cross. All they can do is wait for holy judgment.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
惧怕圣属性的魔物，尤其是不死魔物，会被圣十字攻击的光芒刺瞎双眼。
它们只能等候神的审判。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Based on our latest research,
the Holy Cross can inflict 4.5 times more damage than a normal attack once it is mastered.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
据最新研究，这项技能练到满级后，伤害可达普通攻击的4.5倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Grand Cross...!
The righteous fury of God is
given form in this destructive skill.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
圣十字审判...！
神的正义之怒，化作了这威力惊人的技能。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
God grants us his power so that
we may punish the forces of evil, and one's rage is embodied in a giant crucifix of power.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
神赐予我们力量，惩治邪恶。
心中的怒火，也将化作巨大的能量十字架。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The power of the crucifix of light can damage the enemy three times. Each strike will have five times the strength of your normal attacks.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
光之十字架的力量可以对敌人造成三次伤害。每次打击的威力都是普通攻击的五倍。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, when Crusaders use Grand Cross, they must exercise extreme caution. The human body is too weak to fully embrace the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过，十字军施展圣十字审判时，必须格外谨慎。
凡人的肉体太过脆弱，难以完全承受神的意志。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Therefore, using this skill, will cause the Crusader to suffer from damage. However, this damage can
be reduced to half with Faith.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
因此，使用这个技能会导致十字军受到伤害。不过，通过信任技能，可以将这种伤害减少一半。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
In practicing what we preach, Crusaders choose to protect
others by bearing the suffering of their fellow man.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
为了践行我们的教义，十字军选择通过承受同胞的痛苦来保护他人。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
The Sacrifice skill allows Crusaders to keep their comrades safe from harm by receiving the damage that was intended for them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
牺牲能替同伴承受伤害，护其周全。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It is the greatest demonstration of faith,
as well as of love for your comrades. Such an attitude is essential for a servant of God!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这既是信仰最伟大的证明，也是对同伴之爱的体现。
侍奉神的人，必须怀有这样的心意！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, if the people you want to protect stray away from you, you cannot use the Sacrifice skill for them unless they are close to you again.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过，如果你想保护的人离你太远，你就无法对他们使用牺牲技能，除非他们再次靠近你。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As you visualize the suffering of those you want to protect, you'll never hesitate to sacrifice yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
只要想到要保护的人正承受苦难，你就不会犹豫，甘愿牺牲自己。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Thank you, God, for granting me with the power to protect my people.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
感谢神赐予我力量，守护我的同胞。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Gleipnir is the essence of Megingjard which I have been researching.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
魔法铁链是我一直在研究的雷神腰带的精髓。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It's the only binding strong enough that will allow a human to wear Megingjard around his waist.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
只有它足够坚韧，能让人类把雷神腰带牢牢系在腰间。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Although I can no longer fight, I've been studying how to create Gleipnir for years. I will be more than willing to create it for you if you can bring me...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
虽然我不能再战斗了，但我已经研究如何制作魔法铁链多年了。如果你能给我带来...我很乐意为你制作它。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^0000FF4 Cat Tread^000000,
^0000FF5 Woman's Moustache^000000,
^0000FF4 Root of Stone^000000,
^0000FF3 Sputum of Bird^000000 and
^0000FF3 Sinew of Bear^000000.

[Rebarev Doug]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Why are you wandering
around this sacred place?
Do you not understand that
we must prepare for
the Holy War?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你为什么在这神圣之地游荡？
难道你不知道我们必须为圣战做准备吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
No matter how much I explain, the ignorant never fully understand the importance of our task. The balance of power will shift when we least expect it!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
再怎么解释，无知的人也不懂我们肩负的使命有多重要。
力量的平衡，往往就在意想不到的时候改变！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wish I could go back
to those times when I would
train Crusaders, rather than
preach to the ignorant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
真想回到从前，去训练十字军，而不是对着无知之徒苦口婆心。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I miss my Crusaders who
were enthusiastic to listen to what I had to say, and carried out their orders with loyalty.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我怀念我的十字军们，他们曾热情地聆听我的教诲，并忠诚地执行命令。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I am wonder
where they have
all gone now...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我想知道他们现在都去了哪里...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Adventurer, if you have the time to listen to me speak to myself, why don't you perform a task for me?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
冒险者，有空听我自言自语，不如替我办件事？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It may be an enriching
experience for you. It's possible that you'll even have a greater appreciation for Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
也算是种历练，也许还能让你更懂得欣赏十字军。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: I'm sick and tired of doin' favors.
scripts.translation: 我受够了帮这种忙

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I want you to find the members of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon of the 3rd Company. If you happen to encounter them in your travels, please ask them how they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我要你找到第三连第三排第一小队的成员。如果你在旅途中遇到他们，请询问他们的近况。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It shouldn't be that difficult to do and won't be a waste of your time if you are already planning
to explore the world.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这并不难，如果你本来就打算探索世界，这也不会浪费你的时间。

scripts.text: Sure, why not.
scripts.translation: 好啊，没问题

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but no.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，不行

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Excellent!
All I want you to do is find my old comrades, and inform me of how
they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
太好了！
我只需要你找到我的老战友，并告诉我他们的近况。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However...
There is one problem.
I don't where they are.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过...有个问题。
我也不知道他们在哪。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You could try to find a record of residency changes by citizens of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom in
the Prontera Library...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不妨去普隆德拉图书馆，查查卢恩·米德加兹王国居民的迁居记录...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, the records of
Crusader personnel is considered confidential, so I am not sure of whether or not you can view them.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过，十字军的人员记录被视为机密，我不确定你是否能查阅到。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You must understand, my position requires me to remain in this area 24 hours, 7 days a week. I cannot leave without the consent of the upper hierarchy.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我的职责要求我日夜留守，片刻不能擅离。
没有上级许可，哪儿也去不了。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
However, I know you have the freedom and the time to go wherever you please. I'd appreciate if you would do this for me.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
但是，我知道你有自由和时间去任何你想去的地方。如果你能帮我做这件事，我将不胜感激。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
My old comrades in arms.
You have no idea how much
I miss them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
昔日的战友啊...
你不会明白，我有多想念他们。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Please understand that
I would not be asking this
of you if it were not for
the restraints of
my position.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
请理解，若非受限于我的职位，我绝不会提出这样的请求。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I have an obligation to this Kingdom to keep my post and
inform adventurers about the
Crusader class. Because of this
awesome responsibility, I must
remain here, ever vigilant.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
为王国坚守岗位，向冒险者介绍十字军，是我的职责。
责任如此重大，我必须留在这里，时刻警醒。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If you can't understand, then you must be taking your freedom for granted...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果你无法理解，那你一定是把自由视为理所当然...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As far as I remember, this is the first time I have asked you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
没记错的话，这还是我头一回请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Unlike you, I know the meaning
of responsibility. I remain here, helping inquisitive adventurers for the sake of King and country.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不像你，我深知责任的意义。
我留在这里，为了国王和国家，帮助那些好奇的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Still...
Know this.
Although the results may not be immediate, you will always be rewarded when you help others.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不过...
请记住。
虽然回报可能不会立刻显现，但当你帮助他人时，终将得到回报。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please reconsider
when you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
请你在有机会时重新考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的战友现在过得如何。
我甚至记不清上次见到他们是什么时候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你还没出发去找他们吗？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正准备出发

scripts.text: What do you mean by final mission?
scripts.translation: 你说的最后任务是指什么？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...去普隆德拉图书馆查查^0000FF《排级部队档案》^000000，应该能找到他们下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，你正准备出发...
真不知道从那次^0000FF最后的任务^000000以后，他们都过得怎么样...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Final mission...?
Well, I can't recall
everything at the moment,
but it was the reason why
our squad broke up.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
最后的任务...？
细节一时记不清了，只知道，我们小队就是因此解散的。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We were a great team.
But in the military system,
you need to follow the orders
of your superiors...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我们曾是一支优秀的队伍。
但在军队体制中，你必须服从上级的命令...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If only...
^660000He^000000 hadn't interfered...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
要是...
^660000他^000000没有插手就好了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
...
......

[Rebarev Doug]
Let's not talk about that. What's important that our squad was disbanded because of we failed our final mission. Now, will you please go find ^0000FFThe 3rd Platoon Records^000000 in the Prontera Library for me?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
先不说那些。
总之，最后的任务失败，小队就解散了。
去普隆德拉图书馆，帮我找找^0000FF《第三排记录》^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Remember, it might be helpful to ask the librarian for the file with a record on ^660000the 1st squad's final mission^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
找图书管理员打听^660000第一小队最后一次任务^000000的档案，也许会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I wonder how my old
comrades are doing now.
I can't even remember
the last time I saw them...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
不知道我昔日的战友现在过得如何。
我甚至记不清上次见到他们是什么时候了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hmm...?
Haven't you left
to search for them yet?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你还没出发去找他们吗？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我该去哪里？

scripts.text: I am about to leave.
scripts.translation: 我正准备出发

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Well...
You should be able
find some clue as to
where to find them through
^0000FFThe 3rd Platoon Records^000000 in
the Prontera Library.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...去普隆德拉图书馆查查^0000FF《第三排记录》^000000，应该能找到他们下落的线索。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, you are...
I wonder what they
have been doing since
our ^0000FFfinal mission^000000...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，你正准备出发...
真不知道从那次^0000FF最后的任务^000000以后，他们都过得怎么样...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Huh...?
The librarian
didn't let you
read the records?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
咦...？
图书管理员不让你查阅记录吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
He may have responsibility,
but at the end of the day, he's just like you and me. You can find some way to convince him to help you, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
他虽然身负重任，但说到底，他和你我一样都是普通人。
我相信你一定能找到办法说服他帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Please, I beg you,
would you find out
what happened to the
rest of the 1st Squad?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
拜托了，求求你，请查明第一小队其余成员发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh...
It might be helpful to know that we were the ^660000Crusader Third Company, Third Platoon, First Squad^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，对了，记住我们的番号，应该会有用：^660000十字军第三连第三排第一小队^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh...
So did you meet them?
Are they all okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦...
那你见到他们了吗？
大家都还好吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Rebarev Doug
that although they are
suffering from migraines
and memory loss, the rest
of the 1st Squad is fine.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告诉雷巴列夫·道格，虽然他们正遭受偏头痛和失忆症的折磨，但第一小队的其他成员都还安好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Rebarev Doug
that you have read the
3rd Platoon records and
explain what you have
managed to learn.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告诉雷巴列夫·道格，自己读过第三排的记录，并说明从中了解到的情况。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Oh, I'm glad to hear that
you were able to read the
records! But I don't trust
what's written on paper.
After all, it may be
out of date...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
哦，很高兴听到你成功查阅了记录！
但我并不完全相信纸上写的内容。
毕竟，那些资料可能已经过时了...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If it's possible, I hope you can meet the rest of the 1st Squad face to face, so I can know for sure that they're all alright.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果可能的话，我希望你能与第一小队其余成员见面，这样我就能确信他们都安然无恙。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
A man's life is too
short and his friends
are too few. Please find
out how my old comrades
are doing for me.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
人生苦短，挚友难求。
请替我查明我昔日战友的近况。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Welcome back~
It's been a while since I've last seen you. Have you met the rest
of the 1st Squad?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
欢迎回来~
好久没见你了。你见到第一小队其余成员了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Hm...?
What's that
strange look for?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
嗯...？
你那是什么奇怪的眼神？

scripts.text: Confront Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 质问雷巴列夫·道格

scripts.text: Act unsuspicious.
scripts.translation: 装作若无其事

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou confront Rebarev Doug about the memory problems and migraines of the 1st Squad...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你质问雷巴列夫·道格，为什么第一小队的成员都会失忆和偏头痛...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThinking about Royal Myst's story and the mentions of Egnigem begin to jumble your thoughts...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF想起皇家迷雾的经历，还有几个人提到的艾格尼格姆，你的思绪越发纷乱...^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
What are you talking about? I don't understand, you're talking about lots of different things at once!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你在说什么？我不明白，你一下子说了好多不同的事情！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't look at me like that. If you're done speaking, please
excuse me and tell me your news some other time.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
别那样看着我。
说完了就请回吧，有什么消息，改天再谈。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I appreciate that you've delivered news of my old comrades to me.
Now, I need to continue my research under the command of his Majesty.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
谢谢你带来老战友的消息。
我还得奉陛下之命，继续研究。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou keep your suspicions to yourself and tell Rebarev Doug about the members of
the 1st Squad.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你压下自己的疑虑，向雷巴列夫·道格讲述了第一小队成员的近况。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFOf course, you withhold some details and only tell him what he seems to want to hear.^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当然，你隐去了部分细节，只说了他似乎想听的消息。^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Great!
I'm glad to hear
they're doing so well!
Ha ha! Hahahahahahaahah!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
好极了！
知道他们都过得这么好，我真高兴！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I appreciate that you've delivered news of my old comrades to me.
Now, I need to continue my research under the command of his Majesty. Once again, thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
谢谢你带来老战友的消息。
我还得奉陛下之命，继续研究。
再次感谢你帮忙。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou confront
Rebarev Doug with the
information you learned
from Egnigem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你质问雷巴列夫·道格，拿出了从艾格尼格姆那里得知的情报。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, he didn't
seem the least bit agitated. In fact, he exuded a calmness that makes you feel nervous.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他却丝毫没有慌乱，反而镇定得让你心里发毛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
It's far too late to talk about that, though I feel sorry for you for knowing too much. At this point, there's nothing you can prove.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
现在说这些，已经太迟了。
你知道得太多，我倒真替你可惜。
可事到如今，你什么也证明不了。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
还不懂吗？
这个世界由权贵和强者统治，谁也动不了我！
弱小卑贱的家伙，就去地狱里烂着吧！
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Do you hate me?
Do you really hate me?
Take a look at this face.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你恨我吗？
你真的恨我吗？
看看这张脸。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
This is the
face of authority!
Go ahead and report me to the judge in charge of all military crimes! He's right behind me!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
这就是权力的脸！
尽管去告发我吧，负责审理军中罪行的法官，就在我身后！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
If at least 100 people report the same crime, then maybe he'll hold
a trial. But do you really want to reveal this to the public?
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
如果至少有100人举报同样的罪行，也许他会举行审判。但你真的想把这件事公之于众吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
I didn't think
you'd actually do it.
But you'll be sorry later...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我没想到你真的会这么做。
但你以后会后悔的...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
Don't you get it?
The elite and powerful rule this world. I am untouchable! And the weak and the lowly can rot in hell! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
还不懂吗？
这个世界由权贵和强者统治，谁也动不了我！
弱小卑贱的家伙，就去地狱里烂着吧！
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
You're not fit
to even speak to me.
Even if you are an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
你甚至不配跟我说话。
即使你是个冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
We are Crusaders that have
been training in preparation
for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
我们是十字军，一直在为即将到来的圣战进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Rebarev Doug]
As our forefathers have
done a thousand years ago, we shall vanquish the hordes of Demons when the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[雷巴列夫·道格]
正如我们的先辈在一千年前所做的那样，当那一天到来时，我们将歼灭恶魔大军。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Welcome, friend!
Here in the Prontera Castle, we Crusaders are busily preparing for the Holy War that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
欢迎，朋友！
在普隆德拉王宫，我们十字军正忙着为即将到来的圣战做准备。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Let me introduce myself.
My name is Max Von Shedough, the military judge! Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
让我自我介绍一下。
我是马克斯·冯·谢多，军事法官！你有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou handed
Max Von Shedough
your petition against
Rebarev Doug based on
your investigation
with Egnigem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把依据艾格尼格姆提供的线索调查后写成的请愿书，交给马克斯·冯·谢多，控告雷巴列夫·道格。^000000

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Hm? This is serious.
Alright, I will investigate your claim to the best of my ability.
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
嗯？事情很严重。
好，我会尽全力调查你的指控。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
However, as of now, the petition you've just given me is considered classified information. Please keep this a military secret.
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
不过，目前你刚交给我的这份请愿书被视为机密信息。请保守这个军事秘密。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Unfortunately, I'm not sure if it's possible to hold a trial against Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
不幸的是，我不确定是否有可能对雷巴列夫·道格进行审判。

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
Regrettably, it seems that he still has too much influence. Still, let me assure you that I'll do everything I can...
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
遗憾的是，他在军中的影响力似乎仍然太大。
不过，我保证，一定竭尽所能...

scripts.text:
[Max Von Shedough]
But count on me,
I'll be doing my
best to get him indicted.
scripts.translation:
[马克斯·冯·谢多]
放心，我会尽力让他受到起诉。

啊，请不要触碰这个区域的文件。

through them.
scripts.translation:

这里的一些信息是机密的，因此普隆德拉军方禁止浏览这些文件。

scripts.translation:

我正在那一区查找机密文件，要把它们和公开资料分开。

I'd highly

if you ^660000didn't^000000
interfere with my work.
scripts.translation:

请^660000别^000000妨碍我工作，我就感激不尽了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Darn it...!
I can't read anything when the light is this dim! It's bad enough my eyes have gone bad...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
该死...！
光线这么暗，我什么都看不清！我的视力本来就不好了...

scripts.text: You have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的视力不好吗？

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想查阅文件

scripts.text: Let me help you find those files...
scripts.translation: 让我帮你找那些文件...

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什么样的文件？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I've worked
under dim light
for so long, my eyes have
gone bad. They should get me ^0000FFa new light^000000, otherwise I'll go blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
长期在暗处工作，我的视力都坏了。
他们该给我换^0000FF一盏新灯^000000，不然迟早得瞎...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hey, that's some pretty useful stuff that you've got with you. Do you mind letting me borrow it for a while? It'll help me in finding those files...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嘿，你身上带着一些很有用的东西。介意借给我用一会儿吗？这会帮我找到那些文件...

scripts.text: Yes, I mind!
scripts.translation: 我介意！

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 没关系，拿去吧

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
N-never mind...

[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you are so kind!
Y-you really do want
to help me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
你真是太好了！
你...你真的愿意帮我，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
Now I won't have to
worry so much about
finding that file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
谢谢你...
这样我就不必那么担心找不到那份文件了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If it's alright,
would you help me
look for it...?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
如果不介意的话，你能帮我找找吗...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you...
The stuff you let
me borrow will really
help me in looking for
all of those files...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
谢谢你...
你借给我的东西真的能帮我找到那些文件...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Read some documents?
Well, you've come here
to the Library. That's
a good start.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
想查文件？
嗯，先来图书馆，总算是找对地方了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, as long as
you know what kind
of document you're
looking for, you might
be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯，只要你清楚你在找什么样的文件，也许就能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekin]
I've got to find that
classified file as soon
as I can!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我必须尽快找到那份机密文件！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
Hey, haven't
I told you already?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...？
嘿，我不是已经告诉过你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
The public is prohibited from browsing the files in this section! How many times do I need to repeat myself?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
这一区的文件不对公众开放！
还要我说多少遍？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'd gladly accept your
help if it weren't for the fact that I cannot allow classified information to be released to the public.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我很乐意接受你的帮助，但我不能允许机密信息泄露给公众。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I have no idea how something so important was shuffled into the files here in Prontera Library, but we can't allow the public to access it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我不知道这么重要的东西怎么会混进普隆德拉图书馆的文件里，但我们不能允许公众接触它。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Still, that file doesn't seem to be that important, but I still have to waste my time on finding it...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
不过，那份文件似乎也没那么重要，但我还是得浪费时间去寻找它...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Damn, my eyes are sore.
Working as a government official is easy except for the times when the beaucrats make you do stuff like this.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
该死，眼睛好酸。
当公务员本来挺轻松，偏偏那些官僚就爱给人找这种差事。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I think I'm going to go
insane looking for this file...!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
找这份文件，我觉得我快要疯了...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Huh...?
Did you just say
that you wanted to
help me? I-I'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
咦...？
你刚才说想帮我？
我...我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um, you're not even
supposed to know what
kind of file I'm looking for. Even if you did, I'm not allowed to show you what's inside!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
呃，你本来连我在找什么文件，都不该知道。
就算知道了，里面写了什么也不能给你看！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm. I'm not really allowed to disclose any information related to that file. I'm sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯。我不被允许透露任何与那份文件相关的信息。
很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But isn't
the file about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但那份文件是不是关于...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm...?
How did you
know about that?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...？
你是怎么知道那件事的？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Errmmm...
I don't think so....?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
呃...
我不觉得是那样...？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch the files in this section. Usually, it's public domain but it seems that a classified file managed to get misplaced there.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊，别动这一区的文件。
平时是公开的，可好像有份机密文件混进来了。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For now, I cannot let anyone without special authorization to look through that section. I must find that file and send it to the Prontera military as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
目前，我不能让没有特别授权的人查看那一区。
我必须尽快找到那份文件，并把它送到普隆德拉的军队那里。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ergh! This light isn't bright enough for my eyes. They're starting to get sore again...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啧，灯光太暗，看得眼睛又开始疼了...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
So what brings you here? If you're looking for something in particular, you should try another section.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
那么，是什么把你带到这里来的？
如果你在找特定的东西，你应该去其他区域试试。

scripts.text: I want to read some documents.
scripts.translation: 我想查阅文件

scripts.text: Do you have bad eyes?
scripts.translation: 你的眼睛不好吗？

scripts.text: Let me help you to find the files.
scripts.translation: 让我帮你找文件

scripts.text: What kind of files are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在找什么样的文件？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I told you already! The files in this section aren't open to the public right now! Don't make me repeat myself!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我已经说过了！
这一区的文件目前不对公众开放！
别让我再说第二遍！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Since I have worked under a dim light for a long time, my eyes have gone bad.
They should get me a new light, otherwise I will be gone blind sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
因为我在昏暗的灯光下工作了很久，我的视力变差了。
他们应该给我换一盏新灯，否则我迟早会失明的...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Um? How do you know what file I am looking for?
You don't even know what is written inside?
Stop interrupting me, leave!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯？你怎么知道我在找什么文件？
你甚至不知道里面写了什么？
别打断我，走开！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm... I am not supposed to reveal anything related to the file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...我不被允许透露任何与那份文件相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the file...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那份文件是不是关于...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Maybe...
Maybe not~
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
也许吧...
也许不是~

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hmm? So did you find it? I've been searching for that file for a long time, but I haven't been able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯？所以你找到了吗？
我找那份文件找了好久，但一直没能找到。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and search the right side, so do you think you could search the left?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我先去右边找找，你能去左边找找吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Did you find it yet? All this time, and I still haven't been able to dig up that file.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
找到了吗？
这么久了，我还是没翻出那份文件。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll go ahead and check the left side, so would you look for it in the middle or the right side?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我先去左边查查，你能在中间或右边找找吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah! There it is!
Thank you so much!
I'm glad to see that there are still kind and thoughtful people like you in the world.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊！就是那个！
非常感谢！
很高兴看到世界上还有像你这样善良体贴的人。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I really want to give you something to show you my gratitude, but I've got to send this back to the Prontera Military right away.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
真想送你点什么当谢礼，可我得马上把文件交回普隆德拉军方。

scripts.text: I want to read the document.
scripts.translation: 我想阅读这份文件

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, right, you mentioned that, didn't you? It doesn't seem seem
so important, but I'm not really quite sure...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
哦，对，你是提过。
好像也没什么重要内容，可我也不敢确定...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Well, it couldn't hurt if I made a copy of this first for you to read, but I'll need some materials.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯，先为您复制一份也无妨，但我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I'll even cast the
Search Magic on it, so that it'll be just like the original. All right, I need the following things to make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
我还会施上检索魔法，让副本和原件一样能搜索。
好，抄一份需要这些材料...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
2张光滑的纸，
1张油纸，
3个墨汁，
3根鸟羽，
以及20个蓝色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please get those as soon as possible, and I'll be here making the other preparations to make a copy.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请尽快去准备这些材料，我会在这里做其他复制准备工作。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Also, I'll keep this copy in the Library for you to read, and to prevent it from being leaked to the public. So you'll have to come visit each time you wish to read it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
副本会留在图书馆供你查阅，免得流传出去。
所以，想读就得亲自过来，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Okay, now...
Come back here
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
好了，现在...
请尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Oh, you came back.
I didn't expect you to return here so quickly. Whatever's inside must be really important for you to know.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
哦，您回来了。
没想到您这么快就回来了。
看来里面的内容对您来说真的很重要。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Anyway, please
give me a moment
while I make that
copy for you.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
总之，请给我一点时间，我来为您制作副本。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Alright then...
I'll see you in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
那就这样，待会儿见。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Have you forgotten
what you need to make
a copy? Alright, let me
tell you again...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
您忘了制作副本需要什么了吗？
好吧，让我再告诉您一遍...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
2 Slick Paper,
1 Oil Paper,
3 Squid Ink,
3 Feather of Birds and
20 Blue Gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
2张光滑的纸，
1张油纸，
3个墨汁，
3根鸟羽，
以及20个蓝色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Please come
back with those items
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请尽快带着那些物品回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
让我先过去查看一下文件，然后再制作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Let me go over and review the document before I make a copy...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
让我先过去查看一下文件，然后再制作副本...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
There you go. As I thought, the document didn't seem to contain any crucially important data.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
好了。
果然，里面好像没什么特别要紧的资料。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Just remember, this copy needs to stay in the Prontera Library. That means you have to come back if you need to read the document again.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
请记住，这份副本必须留在普隆德拉图书馆。
这意味着如果您需要再次阅读文件，必须回来。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Welcome, my friend!
So, what do you need today?
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
欢迎，我的朋友！
那么，您今天需要什么？

[Librarian Jekan]
Well...
This is a pretty
obsolete version
of Search Magic,
so I understand if
it's giving you trouble.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嗯...这套检索魔法的版本太老了，不好用也难怪。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Now...
First, if you're going to enter a single search term, like someone's name, you would enter '^660000lee_hester^000000' if you were looking up 'Lee Hester.'
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
先说单个关键词，比如人名。
要找“李·海丝特”，就输入“^660000lee_hester^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Don't use any
capital letters!
And use underscores to
indicate spaces between first and last names and within military unit names.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
千万别用大写字母！
姓名、部队名称中的空格，要改用下划线。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, the Fourth Company would be entered as ^6600004th_company^000000. Now... bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
例如，第四连应该输入为^6600004th_company^000000。
那么...请耐心听我说。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
If you're looking for information on a specific squad, you need to know the Platoon and Company it falls under.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
如果你在寻找特定小队的信息，你需要知道它所属的排和连。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
For example, if you wanted to look up the Crusader 4th Squad of the 4th Platoon of the 4th Company, you would input...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
例如，如果你想查找第四连第四排第四小队的十字军，你应该输入...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
'^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000' all in one line exactly like that. I hope this helps you in your search...
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
“^660000crusader 4th_company 4th_platoon 4th_squad record^000000”，照这样输入在同一行。
希望这些能帮你找到资料...

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
You can tell our
government doesn't
really know how to
allocate its funds
and resources.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
可见咱们政府根本不会分配经费和物资。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
First, there's Jawaii.
Do newlyweds really need
an entire island for themselves? Then again, I am single so I'm probably biased.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
先说爪哇。
新婚夫妻真有必要独占一整个岛吗？
不过，我是单身，可能有点偏见。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
And look at me.
Geniuses aren't supposed to waste their precious time doing useless things for libraries!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
再看看我。
天才不应该浪费宝贵的时间为图书馆做无用的事情！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not touch any books in that section. ...I'm sure there's nothing there that could be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
啊，请不要触碰那个区域的任何书籍。
...我确信那里没有任何对你有用的东西。

scripts.text: Ignore him and check books.
scripts.translation: 无视他并查看书籍

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退后一步

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Hey...!
I thought I said
not to touch those!
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
嘿...！
我说过不要碰那些书！

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Thank you. Feel
free to browse through
the other sections.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
谢谢。请随意浏览其他区域。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
It's really nice to have visitors in the Library, especially when so many people don't read books nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[图书管理员 杰坎]
有人来图书馆，总是件高兴的事，何况现在那么多人不读书。

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
Ah, please do not
touch any books in
that section. There's
nothing useful over in
that section anyway.
scripts.translation:

啊，请不要触碰那个区域的任何书籍。
那个区域反正没有任何有用的东西。

scripts.text: Ignore him and check books.

scripts.text: Step back.

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
I told you...!
Don't touch
the books here!

不要碰这里的书！

scripts.text:

Thank you. Feel
free to browse through
the other sections.

scripts.text:
[Librarian Jekan]
It's really nice to have visitors in the Library, especially when so many people don't read books nowadays.
scripts.translation:

有人来图书馆，总是件高兴的事，何况现在那么多人不读书。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
^333333*Phew...*^000000
This work is really getting to me. Going on a mission with my war buddies sounds a lot better than this.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
^333333*呼...*^000000
这份工作真的快把我逼疯了。和战友一起执行任务听起来比这好多了。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
At least in those days, I felt like I was actually doing something useful!
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
至少在那段日子里，我觉得自己真的在做一些有意义的事！

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Hey...
Can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
嘿...
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ask him about the 1st Squad.
scripts.translation: 询问他关于第一小队的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask him about the 1st Squad's last mission.
scripts.translation: 询问他关于第一小队最后一次任务的事

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Yeah, I was a member of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon a long time ago. How did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
是的，很久以前我是第三排第一小队的一员。你怎么会知道这个？

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I miss the guys back in the squad. I wonder how our leader's been doing recently...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我很想念小队里的兄弟们。不知道我们的首领最近过得怎么样...

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou tell Zan about Rebarev Doug, and about how he is now an instructor for Crusader Boot Camp. He seems to be absorbed in his thoughts of the past.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你说起雷巴列夫·道格的近况，告诉赞他现在是十字军训练营的教官。
赞似乎陷入了对往事的回忆。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Yeah, I was a member of the 1st Squad in the 3rd Platoon a long time ago. How did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
是的，很久以前我是第三排第一小队的一员。你怎么会知道这个？

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I miss the guys back in the squad. I wonder how our leader's been doing recently...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我很想念小队里的兄弟们。不知道我们的首领最近过得怎么样...

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou tell Zan about Rebarev Doug, and about how he is now an instructor for Crusader Boot Camp. He seems to be absorbed in his thoughts of the past.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你说起雷巴列夫·道格的近况，告诉赞他现在是十字军训练营的教官。
赞似乎陷入了对往事的回忆。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
...
......

[Zan.Huadoku]
Before we went out on our last mission, the seven of us were like brothers and sisters. If ^FF0000he^000000 didn't disobey the order, we'd still be together today.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
在我们执行最后一次任务之前，我们七个人情同手足。如果^FF0000他^000000没有违抗命令，我们今天应该还在一起。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Wait...
What was his name...?
There's no way I could forget something like that...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
等等...
他的名字是什么...？
我不可能忘记这种事...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
H-how can I not
remember his name!
He's the reason
my life is...!
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我...我怎么可能记不住他的名字！
就是因为他，我的人生才...！

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
^333333*Groan...*^000000
I.... My head...
My head hurts...

[Zan.Huadoku]
^3355FFZan looks very confused and his eyes begin to glaze with a dazed look. You try speaking to him again, but he doesn't respond at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
^3355FF赞看起来非常困惑，眼神开始变得呆滞。你试图再次和他说话，但他完全没有反应。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
How am I been doing?
Well, I work for the Blacksmith Guild, picking out good weapons
to supply the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我过得怎么样？
嗯，我在铁匠公会工作，挑选好的武器供应给十字军。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Sometimes, I get really
bored with what I'm doing. I keep trying to convince myself that my job's important to future Crusaders, but...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
有时，真觉得这活儿乏味透顶。
总是劝自己，给未来的十字军备好武器很重要，可...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
You know what?
A lot of people have been asking me weird questions about me recently. I feel like I'm getting spied on, but maybe I'm just getting paranoid.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
你知道吗？
最近很多人都在问我一些奇怪的问题。我觉得自己像是在被监视，但也许我只是太敏感了。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Yeah, on our
final mission...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
是的，关于我们最后一次任务...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Final...? What the? I know it happened, but for some reason, all I can envision is a complete blank when I try to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
最后一次...？什么鬼？
明明发生过，可一想起来，脑子里就全是空白。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I...
I guess I need something to remind me? I know it happened, but... I'm so confused.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我...
我想我需要一些东西来提醒我？我知道那件事发生了，但是...我真的很困惑。

scripts.text: ^3355FFZan seems to be having a very difficult time recalling that specific memory of his past.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF赞似乎很难回想起那段往事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
The last mission...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
最后一次任务...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Umm...
Huh. I don't
remember anything.
That's weird. Maybe
I need a bit of a clue?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
嗯...
啊。我什么都不记得。
这很奇怪。也许我需要一点线索？

scripts.text:
^3355FFZan.Huadoku seemed to
have a hard time remembering what had happened in the past. You begin to share with him what you had read in the library about the 1st Squad...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF赞·华独似乎怎么也想不起当年的事。
你便把在图书馆里读到的第一小队记录讲给他听...^000000

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Y-yeah that's right! And then three days after we started the mission, we found some kind of...
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
对、对，没错！
任务开始三天后，我们找到了一种...

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Well, I'm not sure what it was. But we found an ^0000FFunknown fragment^000000 that was a sign from God! And then...!
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
嗯，我不确定那是什么。但我们发现了一块^0000FF未知的碎片^000000，那是神的征兆！然后...！

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
And then...
Oh. Oh God.
I can't remember...

importance of supply?

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Any military force or party needs their supplies to be replenished if they are to continue battling for a prolonged period of time.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
不论军队还是小队，想长时间作战，都得不断补充物资。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
For instance, let's say your group go on hunting without a healer. In this case, everyone would consume health restoration items, like potions.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
例如，假设你的队伍在没有治疗者的情况下进行狩猎。在这种情况下，每个人都会消耗恢复HP的物品，比如药水。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Since you can only carry so many items at once, you'll eventually run out of potions.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
由于你一次只能携带有限数量的物品，你最终会用完药水。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
But if one of your party members traveled between town and the hunting area, he could supply your party with new healing items.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
但如果你的队伍中有一人在城镇和狩猎区之间往返，他就可以为你的队伍提供新的治疗物品。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Supplying your party in this way would let you hunt with less worry. For that duty, the Merchant class would be the best by using their Carts.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
以这种方式为队伍补给，能让你狩猎时更安心。负责这项工作的话，商人职业是最合适的，因为他们可以使用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I suppose that's why I'm working here in the Blacksmith Guild. As weapon quartermaster, I'm obligated to provide supplies for the Crusader forces.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
我想这就是我在铁匠公会工作的原因。作为武器军需官，我有义务为十字军提供补给。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
The Blacksmiths in this guild also help me provide high quality weapons for the Crusades as well.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
公会里的铁匠们也会协助我，为十字军提供高质量的武器。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
If you happen to run out of health items while hunting, why don't you ask a Merchant for help?
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
如果你在狩猎时耗尽了恢复物品，为什么不向商人寻求帮助呢？

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Most likely, they will have some spare items and would be willing to share with you if you ask nicely enough.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
他们很可能带着备用物资，好好开口，也许就愿意分给你一些。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
I hope to see you later again! May Odin protect you on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
期待再次见到你！愿奥丁保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:

In that case.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Let me tell you about some useful knowledge I learned while working with the Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
A Blacksmith character's forging skills are affected by the DEX and LUK stats. DEX and LUK also affect the item creation skills for Alchemists.
scripts.translation:

铁匠的锻造能力受DEX和LUK影响。
炼金术士制作物品的技能，也会受到这两项属性的影响。

scripts.text:
[Zan.Huadoku]
Since I've been staying here in the Blacksmith guild, I'm trying to better understand Blacksmiths and develop a deeper appreciation of their work.
scripts.translation:
[赞·华独]
待在铁匠公会，总想多了解他们，体会这门手艺的价值。

scripts.text:

Take it easy.

慢走。

scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我退役后，妹妹非常生气。她是我唯一可以依靠的人，但现在我把生活搞得一团糟...

[Cuaque Donon]

me a job at her Inn anyway.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
她虽然骂我没用，最后还是在自己工作的旅店里，替我找了份差事。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I've been working there,
living a quiet life. But now, for some reason, a lot of people want to talk to me about something important.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我在那里工作，过着平静的生活。但现在，不知为何，很多人想找我谈一些重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]

scripts.translation:

好像每次终于想起一点事，把他们想知道的答案说出来，他们就要伤害我。

scripts.text:

me here. It's boring and lonely, and the guy downstairs is always yelling at me to leave.

scripts.text:

my sister's a part of comes in sometimes to yell at me. They all want me to tell them something I'm supposed to know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
甚至妹妹所在的流氓公会的人有时也会进来冲我大喊。他们都想让我说出一些我本该知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]

This place is safe from dangerous people, but I don't know for how long.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
但我什么都记不起来！这个地方虽然能避开危险的人，但不知道能维持多久。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Even my sister says I have to tell the Rogue Guild what I should know, or they won't protect us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
连妹妹也说我必须告诉流氓公会我本该知道的事，否则他们就不会再保护我们了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
She looked really sad when she
said that. I don't want to let her down or make her upset. She's
all I have left...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
她说这话时看起来很伤心。我不想让她失望或难过。她是我剩下的唯一亲人了...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, I do remember something!
My sister told me not to tell anyone, but I'm gonna tell you...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哦，我记得一件事！
妹妹告诉我不要告诉任何人，但我打算告诉你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCuaque Donon
whispers into your ears.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF夸克·多农在你耳边低语。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666She said the Rogue Guild wants something from me. So she's gonna send to me to good people that we can trust and can help me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
^666666她说，流氓公会想从我这里得到什么。
所以她打算把我托付给值得信赖、能帮上忙的人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
^666666Still, this is the safest place for me for a while. But I'm always ready to run away if I have to.^000000
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
^666666不过，这里目前对我来说是最安全的地方。但如果有必要，我随时准备逃跑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
How have I been doing?
Lots of people have been coming
to see me. They all want me to tell them something I don't even know!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我最近过得怎么样？
很多人来看我。他们都想让我告诉他们一些我甚至都不知道的事情！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
The Rogue Guild promised to
protect me, but they scare the hell out of me sometimes by coming out of the floor all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
流氓公会承诺会保护我，但他们有时突然从地板下钻出来，真的把我吓坏了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Oh, and my sister said she's
gonna complain to my old boss about something. She said I used to be fine, but now that I've retired, I'm not the same anymore.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哦，妹妹还说，要去找我以前的长官讨个说法。
她说我原来明明好好的，退役以后就变了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
But my old boss from when I was a Crusader doesn't wanna meet my sister. So she's gonna ask help from other Rogues to spread some rumors...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
可我当十字军时的老长官，不肯见妹妹。
所以她想请其他流氓帮忙，把一些传闻散布出去...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Like anyone who works as a Crusader under my old boss will end up like me. You know... broken.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
比如，谁在我老长官手下当十字军，最后都会变成我这样。
就是...坏掉了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I don't know...
I can't even remember.
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我不知道...
我甚至记不清了。

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wait, that's right!
^0000FFMegingjard^000000! Right.
We found it, and
we knew what it was
just by looking at it!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
等等，对了！
^0000FF雷神腰带^000000！没错。
我们找到了它，光看就知道它是什么了！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Megingjard^000000!
^FFFFFFListen to him quietly^000000.
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF静静地听他说^000000

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Waaaaaaaah~!
You're the same
as all the others!
Go away from me!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哇啊啊~！
你跟其他人一样！
离我远点！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I remember after we found it. One of us in the squad had a argument with our old leader. I was keeping night watch and happened to hear it. I think our leader was out of line...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我记得，找到它之后，小队里有人跟以前的队长吵了起来。
那晚我守夜，碰巧听见了。
我觉得，是队长做得不对...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Ergh...
I can't remember
more than that...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
呃...
我记不清更多了...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Megingjard^000000!
^FFFFFFMegingjard!^000000.
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF雷神腰带^000000

scripts.text: ^FFFFFFListen to him quitely^000000
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF静静地听他说^000000

离我远点！

Waaaaaaaah~!
You're the same
as all the others!
Go away from me!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哇啊啊~！
你跟其他人一样！
走开！

scripts.text:

I remember after we found it. One of us in the squad had a argument with our old leader. I was keeping night watch and happened to hear it. I think our leader was out of line...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我记得，找到它之后，小队里有人跟以前的队长吵了起来。
那晚我守夜，碰巧听见了。
我觉得，是队长做得不对...

Ergh...
I can't remember
more than that...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
呃...
我记不清更多了...

I remember after we found Megingjard. One of us in the squad had a argument with our old leader. I was keeping night watch and happened to hear it. I think our leader was out of line...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我记得，找到雷神腰带之后，小队里有人跟以前的队长吵了起来。
那晚我守夜，碰巧听见了。
我觉得，是队长做得不对...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Ergh...
I can't remember
more than that...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
呃...
我记不清更多了...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
I'm getting sleepy
and my head hurts.
Let me rest now...
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
我困了，头也很痛。
让我休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wh-who are you?!
How the hell did
you get in here?!
Get away from me!
Geeeet awwwway!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
你...你是谁？！
你他妈是怎么进来的？！
离我远点！
快...快滚开！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wh-who are you?!
How the hell did
you get in here?!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
你、你是谁？！
你他妈怎么进来的？！

scripts.text:
[Cuaque Donon]
Wahhhhh...!
My head!
It's hurting so bad!
I'm so s-scared!
scripts.translation:
[夸克·多农]
哇哇哇...！
我的头！
痛死了！
我好、好怕！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 询问关于雷巴列夫·道格的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask him about the last mission of the 1st Squad.
scripts.translation: 询问关于第一小队最后一次任务的事

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊！对，第一小队以前的首领。呵。自从我们解散后，我就没见过他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm always busy recruiting future Crusaders.
We always welcome Swordmen
of great ability!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我？对，我一直忙着招募未来的十字军。
我们永远欢迎能力出众的剑士！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
How does it sound? Why don't you volunteer to become a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
听起来怎么样？何不志愿成为十字军的一员呢？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Last mission?
Eh, I don't really remember it.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
最后一次任务？
呃，我不太记得了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Eh...?
Ask him about Rebarev Doug.
scripts.translation: 询问关于雷巴列夫·道格的事

scripts.text: Ask him how he's been doing.
scripts.translation: 询问他最近过得怎么样

scripts.text: Ask about 1st Squad's final mission.
scripts.translation: 询问第一小队最后一次任务的事

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah right. Our old leader.
Now I remember: He was
a pretty self righteous jerk
now that I think about it!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊，想起来了，是以前那个队长。
仔细一想，真是个自以为是的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Can you believe he used to say that ^0000FFno one is more religious than him in this world^000000?! That's egoism right there. And maybe insanity.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
你能相信吗？他以前常说^0000FF这世上没有人比他更虔诚^000000？！这就是自恋。也许还有点疯。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, everyone in the squad
took pride in their faith. When
you're having a rough time in the
real world, you depend on religion, you know?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
总之，小队里的每个人都以自己的信仰为荣。当你在现实世界中过得艰难时，你会依赖宗教，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyways, in the records about
our squad, it says that one of us was punished for insubordination, rebelling or something. That's
a complete lie.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
不管怎样，关于小队的记录里说，我们其中一人因违抗命令或叛乱受到了惩罚。这完全是谎言。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
During our final mission,
our old leader had a huge argument with one us over something we found. I remember it being some kind of godly artifact, but I can't clearly remember what it was.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
最后那次任务，我们找到一件东西，队长为此跟一个队员吵得很厉害。
记得是某件神器，具体是什么，却想不起来。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Although there was an obvious dispute, I think it was our squad leader who was out of line.
I... I can't really say...
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
争执是有，可我觉得，做错的是队长。
我...真说不清...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I can't for the life of me
remember how the guy who
argued with the squad leader
looked like. The higher-ups
musta did something to me...
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我拼命也想不起来那个和首领争吵的人长什么样。上面的人肯定对我做了什么...

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, I know for sure that whatever that guy did, it wasn't insubordination. In fact, I think he might've been right!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
总之，我敢肯定，那个人不管做了什么，都算不上抗命。
说不定，他才是对的！

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
That's all I can remember.
I better take some Green Herbs now. My head throbs like crazy whenever I think about that time.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
这就是我能记起的全部了。
我得吃点绿色药草了。每次想起那段时光，我的头就痛得厉害。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Ah! Yeah, our old leader back in the 1st Squad. Heh. I haven't seen him since we were disbanded.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
啊！对，第一小队以前的首领。呵。自从我们解散后，我就没见过他了。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Me? Yeah, I'm not doing so bad. Keeping busy recruiting future Crusaders. We welcome all
Swordmen if they show potential~
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我？对，我过得还不错。忙着招募未来的十字军。只要展现出潜力，我们欢迎所有剑士~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Why would
you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
哈...？
你为什么想知道这个？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou tell him what you've read in the records for the 1st Squad. Afterwards, Jack O looks a little confused.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告诉他你在第一小队的记录中读到的内容。之后，杰克·奥看起来有些困惑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
I might not be able to remember
a whole lot from back then, but the part about ^0000FFinsubordination^000000 can't be right. I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
哈...？
我可能记不清那时候的很多事了，但关于^0000FF违抗命令^000000的部分肯定不对。我对此很确定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Our old leader was
so arrogant to the point
of being a little off his rocker.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
我们以前的首领傲慢到了有点神志不清的地步。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
I mean, normal people
don't say things like '^0000FFI am the most religious man in the universe! Kneel before me!^000000' Yeah. Not a normal thing to say.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
正常人哪会说什么“^0000FF我是宇宙中最虔诚的人！跪在我面前！^000000”。
对，这可不是正常人说得出的话。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Anyway, if the squad
leader punished anyone for insubordination, I'm sure that it was unwarranted. I don't remember too much, but I'm sure of that.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
所以，要是队长说有人抗命，就处罚了他，那也一定是冤枉人。
记不清太多，可这一点我很确定。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Excuse me, I need to take some Green Herbs. Taking these seems
to be the only thing that works for my headache.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
抱歉，我需要吃点绿色药草。吃这个似乎是唯一能缓解我头痛的方法。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJack O busily chewed
on some Green Herbs.
It seemed to greatly relieve him from the pain of his headaches.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF杰克·奥不停嚼着绿色药草，头痛似乎减轻了不少。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Hey kid!
Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
嘿，小家伙！
有没有想过成为十字军？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Hey kid!
Ever think about
bein' a Crusader?
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
嘿，小家伙！
有没有想过成为十字军？

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Basically, you'd be volunteering to be part of our military, as well as train for the Holy War.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
基本上，你是自愿加入我们的军队，并为圣战进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
If you have some faith and know how to wield a sword, you'll be more than welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
如果你有信仰，并且知道如何使用剑，这里将非常欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Just think about my suggestion
and come back if you're interested. Alright then, see you later~
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
考虑一下我的建议，如果你感兴趣的话再回来。那么，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
It's quiet and boring, as per usual. Let's see if there's any Swordmen I can recruit today.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
一如既往，安静又无聊。看看今天有没有什么值得招募的剑士吧。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
Huh...?
Are you interested in knowing more about Crusaders? Hahaha, I guess that must be the case.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
咦...？想多了解十字军？
哈哈哈，肯定是这样。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
By the way, bring a doll to
the kid in front of me. If you're lucky, she'll give you something neat in return. What it is, I don't know. I've got no dolls.
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
顺便说一句，带个娃娃给我前面的那个小孩。如果你运气好，她会给你一些不错的东西作为回报。是什么，我不知道。我没有娃娃。

scripts.text:
[Jack O]
In accordance with the Crusader code, I'm not supposed to lie. So yeah, you can trust me!
scripts.translation:
[杰克·奥]
根据十字军守则，我不应该撒谎。所以，你可以相信我！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items!
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品太多了！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000还是没回信。
想进卡普拉公司，还得等多久啊。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000 I haven't gotten any response from them. I don't know
if I can wait much longer to join the Kafra Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^333333*叹气...*^000000还是没回信。
想进卡普拉公司，还得等多久啊。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Oh, an adventurer! I actually used to work in the same field that you do. More specifically, I used to be a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
哦，一位冒险者！我实际上以前也从事过和你一样的工作。更具体地说，我以前是一名十字军。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My name is Emma Searth. Right now, I'm following my dream and applying to be a Kafra Lady. So my days of wielding a sword are over.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我叫艾玛·西尔斯。
现在正追寻梦想，应聘卡普拉职员，所以已经放下剑了。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Sadly, I haven't succeeded yet because I was diagnosed with
some weird ^0000FFamnesia^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
不幸的是，我还没有成功，因为我被诊断出患有奇怪的^0000FF失忆症^000000。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Of course, I understand that
Kafra Corporation is a large, professional company, but
if I can work for them even if it's just part-time...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
当然，我理解卡普拉公司是一家大型、专业的公司，但即使只是兼职，我也希望能为他们工作...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Is it that big of a problem?
I suppose they're worried
that I'd forget important customer information once I'm hired.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
这真的是个大问题吗？
我想他们担心我一旦入职，就会忘记重要的顾客信息。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
It's strange. When I was
a Crusader, I remembered
everything lucidly, and I never had any problems recalling the past.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
这很奇怪。当我还是十字军的时候，我记忆非常清晰，回忆过去从未出过任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But now I get these migraines whenever I try to focus on my memories from those times
when I used to fight in the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
但现在，每当我试图回忆在普隆德拉军队服役时的记忆，就会头痛欲裂。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
About her past.
scripts.translation: 关于她的过去

scripts.text: Why be a Kafra Lady?
scripts.translation: 为什么想当卡普拉职员？

scripts.text: About memories she can remember.
scripts.translation: 问问她还记得什么

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe scent of your
Memory Bookmark
seems to bring clarity
to her thoughts.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你身上的回忆书签散发出的气味，似乎让她的思绪清晰了些。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I was born in a wealthy family where I was raised to learn etiquette, fencing, Peco riding, and music lessons since I was
born. I suppose you can say I'm pretty well educated.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我生在富裕人家，从小就学礼仪、击剑、骑大嘴鸟，还上音乐课。
算是受过不错的教育吧。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
However, my parents weren't
pleased when they learned that I wanted to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
然而，当父母得知我想成为卡普拉职员时，他们并不高兴。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
My parents insisted that
I become a Sage or a Scholar.
In the end, I ended up running
away from them by joining the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
父母坚持让我成为贤者或学者。最后，我加入了十字军，逃离了他们。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Luckily, the Crusaders were advertising their recruitment at the time, so I took that chance. Plus, having military experience might even help me join Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
幸运的是，当时十字军正在招募，我就抓住了这个机会。而且，有军事经验也许能帮我加入卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Since I did so well in Boot Camp,
I got the chance to join an elite squad. My squad was often assigned difficult missions, and we never failed to complete those.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
因为我在新兵训练营表现出色，我获得了加入精英小队的机会。我们的小队经常被分配艰难的任务，但我们从未失败过。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Eventually, my reputation as a female Crusader, and being in a respectable military position, was enough to satisfy my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
最终，我作为女性十字军的名声，以及我在军队中体面的职位，足以让家人满意。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
But after that day,
everything went wrong.
I only remember that it
was very sad and depressing.
Somehow, I feel like we were
even betrayed...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
但在那天之后，一切都变糟了。
我只记得那天非常悲伤和压抑。
不知为何，我觉得我们甚至被背叛了...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I think I can
try to remember
my comrades...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我试着...回想一下那些战友...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ah, let's not talk about it. It's too depressing. Maybe if you had some sort of ^0000FFmemory^000000 aid, I might be able to recall my forgotten past. Anything, like a reminder, a scheduler, a bookmark, a string...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
啊，先不说了，太难受了。
要是有什么帮助^0000FF记忆^000000的东西，兴许能让我想起忘掉的往事。
什么都行，提醒用的物件、日程本、书签、绳子...

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
One day, I happened to see Ms. Leilah at work here in Al De Baran. She was shining with confidence and commanded respect, even from her customers!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
有一天，我碰巧看到莱拉女士在艾尔帕兰这里工作。
她自信满满，令人尊敬，甚至顾客们对她都充满敬意！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
She carried herself like a professional, no matter what the situation. Even though I knew she was tired from working in the summer heat, she made everything look effortless!
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
无论情况如何，她都表现得非常专业。虽然我知道她在酷暑中工作很累，但她让一切看起来毫不费力！

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
When the male customers try to flirt with her, she never loses her poise. She just adjusts her glasses and does what she needs to do.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
当男顾客试图搭讪她时，她从不失态。她只是调整一下眼镜，然后继续做她需要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
To me, she's like a lone, guardian angel. At that moment, it seemed the world existed just to be mocked by Ms. Leila.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
在我眼里，她就像一位独当一面的守护天使。
那一刻，仿佛整个世界都只是莱拉女士嘲弄的对象。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I've also heard that Kafra Ladies are always traveling around the world, which is something I've always dreamed of doing.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我还听说，卡普拉职员总是周游世界，这也是我一直梦想着要做的事。

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
Ms. Leilah is my idol,
and she's the reason why
I want to become a Kafra Lady.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
莱拉女士是我的偶像，也是我想成为卡普拉职员的原因。

scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾玛·西尔斯抱着头，因又一次偏头痛而痛苦地皱起眉头。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFRemembering that a Green Herb was able to relieve Jack O, you gave a Green Herb to Emma. She takes it, and looks a little more relaxed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF想起绿色药草曾让杰克·奥缓解过疼痛，你递给艾玛一株绿色药草。她接过去，神情看起来稍微放松了一些。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
I'm not even sure
how much I can remember
and how much I've actually
forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
我甚至不确定自己还能记得多少，又有多少是真正被遗忘的。

scripts.text:

Try to remember every one in our squad. Let's see, there was Jack O, The Nineball. Z-Zan. Zan.H-Huadoku. C-Cuaque Donon. Myself. Um, E... Eni... Egni... Um...

有杰克·奥，九号球。
赞、赞·华、华独。
夸、夸克·多农。
还有我。
嗯，艾...艾尼...艾格尼...嗯...

Egnigem?^000000

Oh no. I'm sure he might
have, no, was there someone
named that with us?

我们队里，有叫这个名字的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Emma Searth]
^0000FFJack O, The Nineball, Zan.Huadoku, Cuaque Donon, Egnigem.^000000 Oh, I really miss those guys...
scripts.translation:
[艾玛·西尔斯]
^0000FF杰克·奥，九号球，赞·华独，夸克·多农，艾格尼格姆。^000000 哦，我真想念那些家伙...

scripts.translation:

quite sure why, but...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Why have you returned to
this lonely place of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你为何回到这孤独的黑暗之地？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Please go back to the world
of the living. To be here is to suffer, such is the nature of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
请回到生者的世界去吧。
留在这里只会受苦，这就是尼芙菲姆的本质。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Greetings...
{0}.
I've been watching you in the
world of the living. I see you've been busy looking for the truth about the 1st Squad, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你好，{0}...
我一直注视着生者世界中的你。
你在四处追查第一小队的真相，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I can provide you with the answers. After all, I'm the only member of the 1st Squad to retain all of my memories...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我可以给你答案。毕竟，我是第一小队中唯一保留所有记忆的成员...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Heh heh...
Let me tell you everything
about the 1st Squad that's
been forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嘿嘿...
那些被遗忘的第一小队往事，我全都告诉你...

scripts.text: The Mission
scripts.translation: 任务

scripts.text: Fate of the 1st Squad
scripts.translation: 第一小队的命运

scripts.text: Why are you in Niflheim?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在尼芙菲姆？

scripts.text: Thanks, I've heard enough.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，我听得够多了

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
First of all, the official record of our mission is misleading.
It contains some truth, based
on verbal evidence, but the most important details have been left out or changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
先说任务的官方记录，那些内容会误导你。
它根据口头证词记下了一部分事实，可最要紧的细节，都被省去或篡改了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, we were secretly assigned
to find ^0000FFgodly artifacts^000000 by royal decree. In only three days, we succeeded and found Megingjard!
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
当时，我们奉王室密令，秘密寻找^0000FF神器^000000。仅仅三天，我们就成功了，并找到了雷神腰带！

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, the records say the mission was unsatisfactory, correct? That would be because of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
记录说，任务以失败告终，对吧？
那是因为我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Are you aware that Megingjard
was a belt worn by gods? It was actually one of the keys to Thor's great strength. Another name for it is the 'Girdle of Might.'
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你知道雷神腰带吗？那是众神使用的腰带，也是托尔力量的来源之一。它还有个名字，叫“力量腰带”。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, if a human were to wear
that, there's a possibility that Megingjard would give him strength comparable to a god. Naturally, you'd be afraid of such a thing falling into the wrong hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
凡人戴上它，或许就能拥有与神匹敌的力量。
这样的宝物落入歹人手中，当然让人担心。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In Rebarev Doug's mind, he
was the only person worthy of the belt since he considered himself the most religious person alive, and thus, closest to the gods.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
在雷巴列夫·道格看来，他是唯一配得上这条腰带的人，因为他自认为是世上最虔诚的人，因此最接近神明。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He made it clear to us that only he would wear Megingjard. Although he was our leader, some of us felt uneasy about him wearing the belt and not giving it to his superiors, our mission objective.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他明说了，雷神腰带只准由他佩戴。
可我们的任务，是把它交给上级。
虽说他是队长，见他想私自戴上腰带，有些人还是心里不安。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Naturally, I opposed him. He was clearly unbalanced, and it would be dangerous to give him control of such power. It led to something of a fist fight between us.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我自然反对他。他显然精神失常，让他控制如此强大的力量是危险的。这导致我们之间发生了一场斗殴。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The rest of the squad couldn't
agree on whether or not we should simply obey our leader and let him have the belt. Some just wanted to complete the mission, while others were afraid of what might happen.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
其他队员也拿不定主意，要不要直接服从队长，让他留下腰带。
有人只想完成任务，有人则担心这样会出事。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev didn't wait for us to decide. He destroyed Megingjard into pieces, intending to keep most of it and somehow reconstruct it later, and only bring one piece to the Prontera Military.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
可雷巴列夫没等我们决定，就把雷神腰带拆碎了。
他想私藏大部分碎片，以后设法重组，只交一块给普隆德拉军方。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He knew that he couldn't get
away with keeping all of Megingjard to himself, as the entire squad could easily discredit him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他知道，如果他独吞雷神腰带，整个小队很容易就能揭穿他。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev knew
that he could deceive his
superiors by giving them just a fragment of the artifact, and say that the rest of it was destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他却知道，交出一块碎片，再谎称其余都毁了，就能骗过上级。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I discovered his intention when
I found him taking Megingjard apart. Before I could stop him,
I was killed. That bastard had
a trap ready for me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
发现他在拆腰带时，我就看穿了他的打算。
可还没来得及阻止，我就被杀了。
那个混蛋，早给我设好了陷阱...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
After the mission, Rebarev Doug only gave a piece of the belt back to the higher-ups, and gave them
a different account than what had actually happened...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任务结束后，雷巴列夫·道格只把腰带的一片交还给了上级，并给出了与实际发生情况不同的说法...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Once the mission was completed, Rebarev Doug reported back to the Prontera Military with the intent of keeping most of Megingjard for himself.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任务完成后，雷巴列夫·道格向普隆德拉军队报告，意图将大部分雷神腰带据为己有。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
For some reason, he has a very strong influence in the military hierarchy. Now, by this time, I'm sure the squad pretty much figured out that he killed me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
不知为何，他在军队高层中有很大的影响力。此时，我相信小队成员已经意识到是他杀了我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
But Rebarev Doug expected this, and explained to his superiors that the squad was tempted by Megingjard's power and that I led some of us in a mutiny against him.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
但雷巴列夫·道格预料到了这一点，并向他的上级解释，说小队被雷神腰带的力量诱惑，而我领导了一些人叛变。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
He told his superiors that Megingjard was damaged as we
fought amongst each other, and that the fragment he gave them was all that remained.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
他告诉上级，雷神腰带在我们内斗中受损，他交给他们的碎片就是仅存的部分。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Because of the confidential nature of our mission, the 1st Squad was disbanded and we weren't given the story Rebarev fed the beaureaucrats until it was too late.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
任务高度保密，第一小队很快就解散了。
等我们知道他向官僚们编了什么谎话，已经太迟。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The squad was punished and
sent for disciplinary retraining for three months. During this time, specific memories were unnaturally erased from the squad members.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
小队受罚，被送去接受三个月的惩戒再训练。
就在这段时间，队员们的某些记忆被人为抹去了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In the end, everyone was transferred to other squads and positions. My name had to be removed from all the records since hearing or reading my name might undo the brain washing.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
最后，大家被调到其他小队或岗位。
我的名字也必须从所有档案中抹去，因为只要听到或读到这个名字，就可能摆脱洗脑。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
However, they still needed an official scapegoat, so they used Royal Myst's name in the records. That's probably why he's been going through hard times right now.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
然而，他们仍然需要一个官方的替罪羊，所以他们在记录中使用了皇家迷雾的名字。这可能就是他最近过得艰难的原因。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
And now Rebarev Doug has been studying godly artifacts based on the pieces of Megingjard that we found on that mission using kingdom research funds. Someday, he might be able to reconstruct the belt.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
如今，他拿着王国的研究经费，用我们找到的雷神腰带碎片研究神器。
有朝一日，说不定真能把腰带重铸出来。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There are also
a few questions that
I've never been able
to answer.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
此外，还有几个问题我一直无法回答。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've never known why the King Tristram III ordered the research of godly artifacts. It also bothers me that Rebarev Doug is in charge of Megingjard's research. There must be some reason.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我始终不明白，特里斯坦三世陛下为何下令研究神器。
研究雷神腰带的人偏偏又是雷巴列夫·道格，也让我放不下心。
其中一定另有缘故。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
In any case, for the sake of Midgard, it will be your responsibility to find the answers.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
无论如何，为了米德加尔特，找到答案将是你的责任。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
There's not much a dead man
can do. But what's worse is that no one remembers me any more. I died alone and I'm still lonely in this place for the dead.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
死去的人，做不了什么。
更难受的是，已经没人记得我了。
生前孤独地死去，来到亡者之地，也依然孤身一人。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The worst part of the squad
having their memories erased is
that Emma Searth has absolutely
no recollection of me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
队员们的记忆被抹去，最让我痛苦的，是艾玛·西尔斯已经完全忘记了我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Do you mind listening
to me for a while? You're
the only person with whom
I can talk about this...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
能听我说一会儿吗？
这些心事，只有你能听我倾诉...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
From here, I've seen that Emma
is chasing her dream again, and
I'm happy for her. But it's still
not easy, knowing the woman you
love has totally forgotten you.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我在这里看着艾玛重新追逐梦想，也为她高兴。
可深爱的女子将自己忘得一干二净，怎么可能不难受。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I remember the first time I met her. I guess it was love at first sight. But I was too cowardly to confess my love, so I despaired when she joined the Crusaders.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我记得第一次见到她的时候。我想那是一见钟情。但我太胆小，不敢表白，所以当艾玛加入十字军时，我感到绝望。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
It took me a while, but I made up my mind to enlist as a Crusader
as well. I wanted to be closer to her so much.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我花了一段时间，但终于下定决心也加入十字军。
我想离她更近一些。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Now, after all our adventures and good times together, I'm in the worst possible scenario.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我们一起冒险，度过了那么多美好的时光，到头来，却落得如此境地。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I'm dead...
But I don't even have the consolation that she is
mourning my loss.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我死了...
却连她会为我哀悼，这一点安慰都得不到。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I suppose that's why I'm here
in Niflheim. I can't quite move on to heaven, Valhalla or anywhere else without her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
或许，我就是因此才留在尼芙菲姆。
放不下她，就没法去天堂、瓦尔哈拉，或别的什么地方。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Anyway, go and visit the Crusader Headquarters. You might be able to learn more about Rebarev Doug and stop any new shadiness he might be plotting. Good luck, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
总之，去拜访十字军总部吧。你可能会了解到更多关于雷巴列夫·道格的信息，并阻止他可能正在策划的新阴谋。祝你好运，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Thank you for
listening to me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
谢谢你听我说话...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
As a Crusader...
This is the best thing
I can do in return for
what you have done for me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
身为十字军...
能用来报答你的，就只有这个了。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Listen...
I'm going to
imbue you with the
^666666last vestiges of my strength^000000...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
听我说...
我将把^666666我最后的力量^000000注入你的体内...

answer me as I call upon the
light of justice that empowers the defenders of truth, and threaten the enemies of peace.
scripts.translation:

愿上天回应我的呼唤，赐予真理守护者正义之光，并威慑和平的敌人。

scripts.text:

May you always shine with
the light of truth. Let the light within you eradicate the shadows
of deception, fear and malice.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Were you betrayed by fate as well, or are you simply a wanderer that's stumbled into this land of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你也是被命运背叛了吗？还是只是一个误入这片黑暗之地的流浪者？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hmm, the living don't deserve
to be in this realm of cold and suffering. But I can only help you escape by telling you what little
I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
生者不该困在这片寒冷痛苦之地。
可我能做的，也只是把自己知道的告诉你，助你逃离。

scripts.translation: 询问关于建筑的信息

scripts.translation:

我明白了。如果你更了解尼芙菲姆的布局，生存和逃脱的机会就会更大。

尼芙菲姆的女巫...
你可以在小地图上我做的^FF3355+^000000标记处找到她的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hrrrm...
It seems that the living who wind up in Niflheim are seeking out the witch. But I don't quite understand what's so important about her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯...
看来来到尼芙菲姆的生者都在寻找那位女巫。但我不太明白她为何如此重要。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The Tool shop? Here in Niflheim, they sell some unique items that
you can't buy anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
工具店？在尼芙菲姆，那里出售一些你在别处买不到的独特物品。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You might want to see their
wares for yourself. I've drawn
a ^CE6300+^000000 on your mini-map to mark
its location.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你或许想亲自去看看他们卖的东西。我已在小地图上用^CE6300+^000000标出工具店的位置。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I've marked the location of the Weapon Shop at ^55FF33+^000000. There's nothing too special over there, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我已在小地图上用^55FF33+^000000标出武器店的位置。不过那里没什么特别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Tavern is at ^3355FF+^000000. They only sell drinks to the dead, though...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
酒馆在^3355FF+^000000。不过他们只向死者出售酒水...

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Choose 'Remove marks on mini-map' from the menu to remove all the building location marks I've made.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
从菜单中选择“移除小地图上的标记”即可移除我做的所有建筑位置标记。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Alright, all the marks I've made have been removed from your mini-map. If you want to check the locations in Niflheim again, go ahead and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
好了，小地图上的标记全都清除了。
若还想查找尼芙菲姆各处的位置，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
You're gonna explore this place on your own? Pretty brave, aren't you? Just be careful: here in Niflheim, darkness reigns supreme.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你要独自探索这个地方吗？真勇敢啊。不过要小心：在尼芙菲姆，黑暗才是主宰。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
I really wish that
Emma Searth could
remember me...
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
我真希望艾玛·西尔斯能记得我...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHis eyes seemed
to moisten with sadness.
Is it really possible for the
dead to shed tears?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他的眼中似乎泛起了悲伤的泪光。
死者真的会流泪吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Were you betrayed by fate as well, or are you simply a wanderer that's stumbled into this land of darkness?
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
你也是被命运背叛了吗？还是只是一个误入这片黑暗之地的流浪者？

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hmm, the living don't deserve
to be in this realm of cold and suffering. But I can only help you escape by telling you what little
I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
生者不该困在这片寒冷痛苦之地。
可我能做的，也只是把自己知道的告诉你，助你逃离。

scripts.text: Ask him about buildings.
scripts.translation: 询问关于建筑的信息

scripts.text: Remove marks on mini-map.
scripts.translation: 移除小地图上的标记

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
...I see. Now, let me introduce you all buildings in Niflheim!
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
...我明白了。那么，让我为你介绍尼芙菲姆的所有建筑吧！

scripts.text: Witch's Castle
scripts.translation: 女巫城堡

scripts.text: Tool Shop
scripts.translation: 工具店

scripts.text: Weapon Shop
scripts.translation: 武器店

scripts.text: Tavern
scripts.translation: 酒馆

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
The witch of Niflheim...
You can find her castle at the ^FF3355+^000000 mark I've made on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
尼芙菲姆的女巫...
你可以在小地图上我做的^FF3355+^000000标记处找到她的城堡。

scripts.text:
[Egnigem]
Hrrrm...
It seems that the living who wind up in Niflheim are seeking out the witch. But I don't quite understand what's so important about her.
scripts.translation:
[艾格尼格姆]
嗯...
看来来到尼芙菲姆的生者都在寻找那位女巫。但我不太明白她为何如此重要。
